plain: Giving the main points briefly, in a short space.

webster.text: Short; summary; abridged; comprehensive; containing the substance or general principles of a subject or work in a narrow compass; as a compendious system of chimistry; a compendious grammar.

more.text: Short; direct; near; not circuitous; as a compendious way to acquire science.

example.quote: It will be my aim to remove the obstacles from your progress in as compendious a manner as it can be done, without sacrificing utility to despatch.
